title: A Fungal Defensin Inhibiting Bacterial Cell-Wall Biosynthesis with Non-Hemolysis and Serum Stability

materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF/OA package/supplement ZIP and linked database JSONL rows were sufficient for supported activity, database conflict preservation, and mechanism adjudication.

per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_2_activity_toxicity: Repaired empty activity layer with 12 primary-source Table 1 CL rows and two qualitative toxicity/stability rows from Results/Figure 5; CL was preserved as CL, not converted to MIC.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_4_database: DBAASP LC assay rows match Table 1 and were source-verified; exact 0% hemolysis, CAMP MIC relabeling, and APD6 database-only/future-update claims were preserved as conflict/database-only cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_adjudication: Full source review reopened XML, PDF text, OA package figures, supplement ZIP/PDF, and linked database rows; no blocking issue remains after preserving source conflicts explicitly.
per_layer_decision_rationale.mechanism: Replaced generic mechanism placeholders with source-located direct and supportive claims for cell-wall biosynthesis inhibition, non-permeabilizing PI result, SEM morphology, and Lipid II model support.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary Table 1 reports lethal concentration (CL) from inhibition-zone assay; CAMP/database text relabeling as MIC is not normalized to MIC.
Primary text supports no significant hemolysis across 3.125-25 µM, but exact 0% hemolysis is database/figure-derived rather than text-reported.
APD6 entry includes sequence/formula and later recombinant-production text not sourced to the 2022 paper; preserved as database_only_no_primary_source.
Supplement ZIP was opened and contains only a Figure S1 PDF supporting SEM morphology; it has no hidden activity/toxicity table.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework resolved the prior empty activity layer and unadjudicated database placeholders for Py4. The paper is publication-grade with explicit cautions for CL-vs-MIC relabeling, database-only APD6 details, and qualitative hemolysis/stability evidence.
